description: This file defines the configuration class 'ClaimPluginConfiguration' for the Claim plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements initialization logic to register the ClaimService in the dependency container.

classes.name: ClaimPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the Claim plugin, responsible for initializing and registering claim-related services.
